summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its annual general and special meeting of shareholders held August 11, 2026. All five director nominees were elected with over 97% votes for. Shareholders also approved fixing the board at five, appointing Davidson Company LLP as auditor, and approving an Amended and Restated Shareholder Rights Plan with 91.07% support. This is a routine meeting results disclosure with no special-situation event such as a takeover, tender offer, or restructuring. The shareholder rights plan approval is standard governance, not an active special situation. The filing is purely informational regarding corporate governance matters.
